Planys Technologies Private Limited

Founders: TANUJ JHUNJHUNWALA, VINEET UPADHAY, Prof PRABHU RAJAGOPAL & Prof KRISHNAN BALASUBRAMANIAN
(IITM alumni & Faculty members)
@planystech
What it offers? 
Planys is an Indian deep tech startup creating a paradigm shift for smart underwater inspection across the world.  Planys is steering a new course in the maintenance and inspection industry with its disruptive innovations in the field of marine robotics, novel underwater non-destructive testing (NDT) methods and AI enabled post-inspection analytical digital reporting dashboard. Planys’ technology solutions help asset owners or managers take a data-driven decision for efficient planning of maintenance and repair. Current clients: PSUs & corporates in Maritime (Ports, Terminals, Shipping), Infrastructures (Dams & Bridges) & Energy (Oil & Gas, Power, Hydroelectric) sectors. Planys also operates in Singapore, Netherlands and Middle East. Visit us online 
Funds raised: ₹14 crore ($2.1 M) in Series A from ONGC, Ranjan Pai's MEMG Family Office, Kris Gopalakrishnan's Pratithi Trust and HNIs (Feb 2018); ₹1.5 crore grant-in-aid from BPCL under the Oil PSU's Startup scheme 'Project Ankur' (Nov 2017); $260k angel investment by Keiretsu Forum, Chennai & Singapore Chapters and Ministry of MSME (GoI) Grant (Dec'15)

Grinntech Motors & Services Private Limited

Founder: PUNEET JAIN
Domain: Energy Storage 
What it offers?
Grinntech aims to enable scaling up of electric vehicles by making them technically and economically feasible. Battery packs constitute major part of an electric vehicle. Grinntech aims to bring that down by introducing new innovative business model and technology products which are build considering price sensitivity & engineering needs of Indian market. Grinntech is building battery management systems for lithium battery packs & doing electro-mechanical packaging of lithium battery packs. Visit us online 
Funds raised: Seed funding by RTBI (2018)
